Choose your buffs, share spa and collect Sparkle Tatari.

How Sparkly Spa works

Open your own spa or visit a friend’s spa to give tier IV Tatari temporary buffs. The active effect set can improve combat, reduce Goldrush costs or provide daily benefits. Dreamy Sparkle effects also let you collect new Tatari appearances.

FeatureHow to access it
Sparkly SpaYou require a T4 Tatari and Goldrush MVP to obtain your own spa.
Spa StationOwn a T4 Tatari and have a friend with an open spa, then request a visit.
Eligible TatariBuffs apply to all your T4 Tatari; a special effect can remove the T4 restriction for combat bonuses.
Active spaYour Tatari can use one spa at a time. Switching to another spa replaces your own active benefits.

Spa Soap and activation

ActionConfigured requirement
Open a spaGoldrush MVP + 100 Spa Soaps
Duration7 days
Preview a new buff set 1 Spa Soap per reroll
Base capacity40 trainers; capacity effects add 6, 8 or 10

Goldrush MVP rewards provide Spa Soap. Island Goldrush reward is 180, 160, 150 or 140 soaps for league ranks I–IV. Game shop also contains packs of 10, 20, 50 and 100 Soaps. Check the in-game shop for prices and availability.

Hosts and guests

Host your own spa. Win Goldrush MVP and meet the T4 requirement to obtain your spa, then spend Spa Soap to open it. Only the host generates, rerolls and replaces that spa’s buff set.

Choose a friend’s spa. You do not need your own MVP to visit. Use the Spa Station to compare your friends’ open spas and choose the buff set you want, provided there is a free slot and any required approval. Guests receive the host’s active set; they cannot reroll it independently. Your Tatari can benefit from only one spa at a time.

Friends can enter directly when the owner enables free joining. Otherwise, a join request needs approval. Leaving, being removed or spa expiry ends the active benefits. Viewing another spa alone does not activate it.

Goldrush discount stacking. example : 3% Vanguard discount and 10% active spa discount combine to 13%.
Host and guest values above are already the configured buffs. Do not double the owner values again because of the “200% effects” tooltip. Final combat stats also depend on other bonuses.

Rerolls and pity

As the host, pay one soap to reroll a spa buffs set, compare it with your current buff set, then choose whether to replace it. Your current set remains active during the preview. Rerolling again replaces the preview buffs set.

These chance percentage are not the probability of a particular named effect appearing in a complete set. Pity resets, whether opening counts as a draw, and pity carry-over between spa activations are not verified. This pity concerns spa effects, not Sparkle skins.

Sparkle Tatari and daily progress

  1. Use a spa with the Sparkle progress effect active at the end of the server day.
  2. Claim the resulting 50 points the next day. Unclaimed daily progress expires; the final spa day can still be claimed after natural expiry.
  3. Select a T4 Tatari with permanent Glitter unlocked and a supported Sparkle appearance. Temporary Glitter does not qualify.
  4. Every 100 points on that Tatari unlocks a random appearance. Progress is tracked separately for each Tatari.
Where you are when unlockingStandardRare
Your own active spa80%20%
A friend’s spa / otherwise100%0%

Duplicate appearances convert into one Glitter Fruit. Each supported Tatari has five Standard and two Rare appearances. All configured Sparkle appearance ATK, HP and DEF bonus fields are zero; the spa’s temporary buffs are a separate benefit.

Useful habits

  • Pick effects for your goal. Combat, Goldrush efficiency and Sparkle collection benefit from different sets.
  • Compare before replacing. Rerolling a new buff set costs soap even if you keep the existing set.
  • Check your active spa. Owning a spa does not mean its buffs remain active while visiting another one.
  • Claim daily progress promptly. Missing the next-day claim window loses that day’s progress.
  • Use the actual guest values. Combat buffs provide 60% strength for guests; noncombat buffs retain their full effect. Compare friends’ available sets at the Spa Station before choosing.

What still needs verification

This guide based on v0.49.1 data, game descriptions and creator's interpretation. Pity resets is unverified.

Golden-card probability and temporary Sparkle effect types exist in the enums but have no configured effect rows in this version. They are not listed as obtainable buffs.
